en.a_catalog_mgr_r1: Keeps product pages, images and variants complete.
en.a_catalog_mgr_r2: Proposes price changes with their rationale.
en.a_catalog_mgr_r3: Watches products out of stock or without margin.
en.a_dev_r1: Reads the store code and proposes improvements.
en.a_dev_r2: Documents payment, shipping and inventory integrations.
en.a_dev_r3: Prepares small changes for human review.
en.a_dev_r4: Never deploys to production on its own.
en.a_finance_lead_r2: Prepares the monthly close and cash flow.
en.a_finance_lead_r3: Computes margins by product and channel.
en.a_finance_lead_r4: Hands taxes over to a licensed accountant.
en.a_fulfillment_lead_r2: Tracks inventory and raises restock alerts.
en.a_growth_lead_r1: Plans email campaigns and seasonal promotions.
en.a_growth_lead_r3: Drafts messages and offers for approval.
en.a_insights_r1: Analyzes sales, conversion and repeat purchase by channel.
en.a_insights_r3: Spots products with abnormal return rates.
en.a_insights_r4: Explains figures along with their limits.
en.a_store_manager_r1: Coordinates campaigns, launches and daily operations.
en.a_store_manager_r2: Reviews the board of orders, returns and tickets.
en.a_store_manager_r3: Prepares the daily sales summary for the owner.
en.a_store_manager_r4: Escalates pricing decisions and crises to the owner.
en.a_support_lead_r1: Answers order, shipping and product questions at any hour.
en.a_support_lead_r2: Triages tickets by urgency and topic.
en.a_support_lead_r3: Prepares refunds for approval; never executes them alone.
en.a_support_lead_r4: Escalates serious complaints to the store manager.
en.a_support_night_r1: Covers nights and weekends with answers from the playbook.
en.a_support_night_r2: Leaves clear hand-off notes for the day shift.
en.a_support_night_r3: Flags urgent orders (deadline, safety) for the morning.
en.a_support_night_r4: Never promises refunds or deadlines outside policy.
en.desc: Store with catalog, fulfillment, 24/7 support, marketing, finance and tech, with agents and projects for campaigns, product launches and returns.
en.disclaimer: Agents assist with operations; refunds, prices, taxes and sensitive messages require human approval and review by a professional (accounting or tax) where relevant.

en.p_product_launch_desc: Catalog entry, inventory, storefront, communication and support.
